r9.reason: R9 moves from beholding Christ to the authority of the risen Judge and prevents X.1 from appearing as an isolated fear appendix.
r9.forbidden: Do not merge R9 into R8 in a way that removes the Revelation material or repeat the whole eschatology of X.1.

katoptrizomenoi.placement: R8 textual note after the main 2 Corinthians 3:18 exposition
katoptrizomenoi.maximumPurpose: Explain the translation range mirror/behold/reflect and why the chapter's central transformation claim does not depend on one disputed English gloss.
katoptrizomenoi.forbidden: Do not create a separate chapter, do not claim one gloss is lexically certain, and do not use the excursus to inflate source counts.

directQuotes.rule: Reader chapters paraphrase the approved dossiers and cite canonical loci; any new quotation requires a registry update with locator/version/context.

deduplication.edenVsFall: I.2 owns creation/fall sequence; later chapters may summarize but not repeat the full Genesis narrative.
deduplication.repentanceVsRegeneration: III.3 owns repentance and fruit; regeneration chapters own causal renewal and must not duplicate the pastoral receipt ladder.
deduplication.r9VsX1: R9 owns the person and authority of the risen Christ; X.1 owns resurrection, judgment and final outcomes.
deduplication.x1VsX2: X.1 owns the judicial fork; X.2 owns positive glorification and liberated-heart description.
